div.div:
1 مَصَدَهَا , aor.
مَصُدَ , (M,) inf. n. مَصْدٌ, (S, M, L, K,) He sucked her breast (Lth, S, M, L, K) in a certain manner. (S, M, L.) You say, قَبَّلَهَا فَمَصَدَهَا He kissed her and sucked her breast. (Lth, L.) ―
-b2- مَصَدَهَا, (IAar, L,) inf. n. مَصْدٌ; (IAar, L, K;) He sucked her (a damsel's) saliva from her mouth; like مَصَّهَا, and رَشَفَهَا, and رَفَّهَا: (IAar, L:) and مَصَدَ he sucked (IAar, S, L, K) saliva. (IAar, S, L.) ―
-b3- مَصَدَهَا, (S, M, L,) aor.
مَصُدَ , (M,) inf. n. مَصْدٌ, (S, M, L, K,) Inivit eam, (S, M, L, K,) quodam modo; (M;) scil, ancillam suam. (L); as also مَزَدَهَا, inf. n. مَزْدٌ. (M.) ＝
-A2- مَصَدَ, inf. n. مَصْدٌ, He brought under; subdued; rendered submissive; syn. ذَلَّلَ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
